### Community Engagement Verification (CEV)

Advanced AI-enhanced platform for state agencies to automate and manage the verification of Medicaid beneficiaries' community engagement activities under federal mandate requirements.

**Key Features:**

- Three-tier processing framework (60-70% automated, 20-25% tech-enabled, 10-15% manual)
- AI-powered document processing and verification workflows
- Multi-state SaaS architecture with physical data segregation
- Zero Trust security architecture with HIPAA compliance

**Documentation:**

- [CEV Conceptual Design](cev/conceptual-design.md) - Comprehensive solution architecture
- [Georgia Use Case Analysis](cev/georgia-use-case.md) - Implementation lessons learned and best practices
